en: Vintage black‑and‑white/hand‑tinted street scene showing a busy urban square with multi‑story buildings featuring balconies and traditional enclosed glass galleries. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the cobbled square, with horse‑drawn carriages and an early tram or cart visible. A large circular purple stamp from a public library appears in the upper right. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Vigo. – Puerta del Sol." indicating the location as the Puerta del Sol square in Vigo, Spain.
